prompt:
A real photograph, taken with a good phone camera and looking exactly like a phone photograph, of a night nurse coming quietly into a dark hospital room where an old patient lies awake, in a wide horizontal picture, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, the dark of the night, only the dim light from the corridor through the open door and the small beam of a pen torch. The textures of real cotton, wool, plastic, steel, skin and hair, with the true depth and the slight lens perspective of a photograph.

The third reference picture is a real phone photograph of the same hospital room by day: use it for the room and the furniture. Now it is the middle of the night.

HERR BRANDT, a patient of eighty-two, the person of the first reference picture (that picture gives the face, the hair and the build; here the person is in the place described below), the face, skin and hair exactly as in it: white hair, a white moustache, in pale-blue pyjamas, lies in the bed on the right of the picture, awake, his eyes open towards the door.

YUSUF, a nurse of thirty-four from Syria. The second reference picture shows Yusuf: his face, hair and build stay exactly as in it. He wears a plain white short-sleeved nurse's tunic, plain white trousers and white closed shoes. He comes in through the door on the left of the picture, on tiptoe, holding a small pen torch pointed down at the floor, his eyes on the patient.

The whole picture carries no writing, numbers, print, symbol or logo anywhere: the clothes have no name badge, no embroidery and no brand, every paper is blank or carries only grey lines and empty boxes, and every screen shows only plain pale-blue panels.
